items.q: her father hired the Ray Noble band ... and Ray and Bill Hardy said, 'Out of the way,' and just pushed him aside and we went in

ctx.x:
different languages.
Another marvelous thing happened with him. As you know, musicians were always through the years, pretty much treated like waiters, and they should have been treated like artists, you know, so whenever you played a swanky party, you always went through the kitchen and I wrote a story about this called, 'We Don't Go Through the Kitchen Any More,' and it has to do with this. We were playing in the Rainbow Room and some debutante was coming out and she hired -- her father hired the Ray Noble band…

So we came in the front way and surely enough, we were greeted by a British butler, of all things, and he said, 'Oh, around the back and through the kitchen, fellows,' and Ray and Bill Hardy said, 'Out of the way,' and just pushed him aside and we went in and sat in the drawing room and just sat around and waited for the debutante to come and she came and was very upset and she said, Mr. Noble, I hired you for 4:00 and I think we should have some music immediately,' and Ray said, 'The boys haven't had a drink yet…

then we started to play. Now, we had a contract for a lot of money, maybe two or three hours, and we played about one hour, and then she came and she wanted the band to play later and Ray said, 'Oh, no, nothing doing, we're very tired.'
